unmatched.other_notes: Paper focuses on environmental impact of ML training, which does not map cleanly to existing area/task enums.

rationale_short: The paper presents a carbon emissions calculator tool for ML training. Primary contribution is a tool/system (ToolLibrarySystem). Area is 'Other' because GreenAI/sustainability is not in the enum. Task topics include Efficiency and a custom 'CarbonFootprintEstimation'. The paper is general-purpose and cross-domain.

area.definition: Research focused on the environmental impact, energy efficiency, and carbon footprint of AI/ML systems.

task_topic.definition: Estimating or reducing the carbon emissions and environmental cost of training or deploying ML models.
